prompt: Review whether Applied Materials has a material causal relationship to AI compute, networking, and hyperscaler monetization using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: AI compute expansion raises leading-edge logic, DRAM, HBM and advanced-packaging process complexity, increasing demand for Applied Materials deposition, etch, planarization, metrology and installed-base services when customer fab and packaging capacity converts into orders.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if AI-related fab and advanced-packaging demand is immaterial to Applied Materials revenue, customer capex rolls over, or competition, export controls and pricing absorb the materials-intensity benefit.
